run_get_one_face: run the get_one_face function to extract the leftmost face from a video frame
run_get_many_faces: run the get_many_faces function to detect all faces in a video frame
run_get_unique_faces_from_target_video: run get_unique_faces_from_target_video to extract and cluster face embeddings from a target video
run_get_unique_faces_from_target_image: run get_unique_faces_from_target_image to extract unique faces from a target image
run_simplify_maps: run simplify_maps to compress source-target face mappings into a single embedding-based map
